title: A cwd-relative glob scans empty in the sandbox cwd: Tavotto draws a figure with no data, native draws the real one
affected_script_shapes: a script that lists its data with a cwd-relative glob.glob(...) (directly or inside a helper) and plots whatever came back
root_cause: In the sandbox cwd the glob matches nothing, the script keeps running and plots an empty series (ax.plot([])), so Tavotto shows an empty figure (pixel / structure / edit differences) or fails later downstream; `python script.py` in the script directory finds the files (issue #1254). The behavior is kept on purpose (ADR 0047 / 0084: the read-only fallback does not extend to glob / exists / C++ readers); the root cure is the project-level 'run in the script directory' switch. What was fixed is the diagnosis: #1299 observes relative probes that came back empty at run time, and attaches workdir_hint ('run in the script directory') to the error or to the no-figure result when the script directory has what the sandbox lacked.

verified.route: Safe engine path via the product discovery chain, sandbox cwd

unverified: a real user session through the UI (the workdir_hint is covered at the engine / HTTP-body level, not clicked)
the project-level 'run in the script directory' switch (it is the root-cause fix, not a default)

recurrence: edit_failed, pixel_mismatch and structure_mismatch 2 candidates each in the weekly sweep (run 39758109474, main 602ccf61f, seed 202643), all from the glob_dir transform on shape_custom_entry / shape_local_helper_import
